name: hlhb / BTCUSDT spot 4h

signal.entry: RSI crosses above50 AND EMA5 crosses aboveEMA10 AND ADX>25 AND volume>0
signal.exit: simultaneous same-bar crossed_below RSI50/EMA5 EMA10 AND ADX>25 AND volume>0
signal.crossing: current strict >/<; prior inclusive <=/>=; NaN false
signal.conflict: entry and exit simultaneously true forbids entry/indicator exit; risk remains
signal.position_stacking_source_attribute: string True is not framework config; actual config fixed False

risk.roi_suppression: current available delay-shifted entry signal suppresses ROI for current bar whether or not a new order fills; stop/trailing unaffected
risk.roi_clock: floor wall-clock minutes from effective open entry; intrabar entry uses trading interval end+1ms as conservative age origin, no exact entry timestamp asserted
risk.roi_inside_bar: tier chosen at effective observable open and held all bar; same-entry-bar tier0; minute thresholds inside bar deferred next open
risk.roi_price: entry_fill*(1+entry_fee)*(1+roi)/(1-exit_fee), exit limit; 0ROI exact limit nets zero excluding favorable gap
risk.trailing_activation: fee-aware peak>offset threshold uses positive trailing; peak==threshold updates stop using original-.3211 fraction without activating positive; peak<threshold no update
risk.samebar_path: synthetic deterministic O-L-H-C price ordering; not conservative bound and not native Freqtrade backtest path
risk.samebar_priority: open buy if marketable, then stop gap > signal limit exit > ROI; ascending paths earliest touched signal/ROI limit first with exit_signal tie priority; falling path stop; same-bar newly-filled entry subject to remaining path; no reentry after exit

execution.limit_quote: signal bar close, observable before order; no reprice. buyhold is market control
execution.timeout: current observed bar only; cancel next effective open; no rehang absent a fresh delayed signal
execution.limit_fill: full fractional fill at touch inclusive <= for buy, >= for sell. favorable opening fill=raw open adverse2bps capped at limit; intrabar fill at exact limit, no adverse beyond limit
execution.queue_and_partial_fills: not modeled; touch is not proof of executable fill
execution.reservation: no cash is deducted until fill; no borrowing or multiple orders; unfilled order consumes no account cash
execution.pending_exit_risk: unfilled sell order competes with stop and ROI; risk exit cancels order. expiry does not close position
execution.terminal: mark final close; no forced sale or hypothetical closing fee; open limit would be terminal-cancelled
execution.known_halt: 2023-03-24 11:27–14:00; label12h uses effective14h matched1h-open proxy;08h intrabar upper11:26:59.999;12h lower14h; no invented12h fill
execution.time_precision: open timestamps are diagnostic bar/resumption proxies; intrabar event time=null, earliest/latest bounds only; synthetic path segments are not timestamps

input.reason_not_trusted_loader: explicit spot diagnosis outside perpV3; pinned integrity+equivalent raw row audits; strict finality/PIT/tradability unproven
